A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and matchable, including relocated tables and the renumbered case-study appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original Qwen3 benchmark evaluations, interpolation sweeps, weight-similarity measurements, and ablations, including the Qwen3-30B-A3B results in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds DARE/SLERP comparisons in Table 2 and Llama interpolation experiments in Appendix C and Figure 7.

M1.justification: The weighted parameter interpolation in Equation 6 and its underlying procedure remain unchanged. The Llama experiment applies the existing method to another model pair without introducing a new algorithmic component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate AIME’25, IFEval, and GPQA-Diamond with the same task coverage. The added Llama experiments reuse AIME’25 and GPQA-Diamond; they expand model configurations rather than datasets or task requirements.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds DARE and SLERP to the Qwen3-4B comparison across all three benchmarks, retaining TA, TIES, their Base variants, and the unmerged models. The Qwen3-30B-A3B comparator set in Table 5 is unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix C adds interpolation sweeps using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. Existing Qwen evaluation settings remain unchanged. The broader Vote@k description does not establish a metric change, since v1 already reports it for AIME’25.

E4.justification: Appendix C and Figure 7 add a cross-family analysis testing whether the three-stage interpolation pattern extends beyond Qwen. The decoding, layer, module, and alternative-backbone analyses remain, as do both case studies, now under Appendix D.

E5.justification: The stated 64 generations for AIME’25, eight for the other benchmarks, and unbiased Pass@k estimator are retained. No new seed information, independent-run reporting, confidence intervals, or significance tests appear.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds DARE and SLERP results, including AIME’25 Mean@64 scores of 61.4 and 62.6. Figure 7 adds Llama results, including decreasing AIME’25 token counts in the final interpolation stage. Matched existing Qwen scores and original figure data remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 retain the same mathematical definitions and derivations, including the equivalence between interpolation and weighted task arithmetic. No new assumptions, theorems, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the three-stage paradigm, efficiency/effectiveness claims, and mechanistic ablation contributions. The additional experiments support these existing claims without redefining the core contribution.

C2.justification: Appendix C newly interprets Llama results as confirming the three-stage pattern while allowing architecture-dependent coefficient ranges and stability zones. Section 4.2 changes the Stage 2 peak description from 'within or at the end' to 'at the end' and removes the benchmark qualification on token reductions. The limitations paragraph remains unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 removes the project GitHub link from the abstract. Section 4.3 also removes TA’s 0.7 scaling factors and TIES’s 0.2 sparsity and 0.5 scaling factor, retaining only a reference to prior work. These are losses of reproducibility information; actual repository availability is not established.

R1.justification: v2 adds Goddard et al. (2024), Arcee’s mergekit, and positions SLERP and DARE as evaluated comparators. The additional Yu et al. (2023) reference duplicates the work already cited as Yu et al. (2024), rather than adding another distinct work. Broader research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: Changes include localized copyediting, revisions to the baseline and stage descriptions, and a short new Appendix C. The case-study appendix becomes Appendix D with updated cross-references. Most prose and the main section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure 7 and expands Figure 3’s caption. Table 2 replaces the MI-0.45 and MI-0.55 rows with DARE and SLERP; the interpolation curves remain in Figure 3. Table 1 switches columns, and Table 5 moves to a separate page. Existing figures are otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added comparators and non-Qwen experiment provide useful evidence. However, Figure 7 shows falling final-stage AIME’25 token counts, which v2 does not reconcile with its increasing-cost Stage 3 description while claiming confirmation. v2 also removes the code link and explicit baseline settings and retains a limitation proposing Llama validation as future work. These empirical benefits and reproducibility and interpretation regressions leave the net quality direction uncertain.
